scenarios.name: Exact Activity ID Match
scenarios.description: Field report contains explicit Activity ID (ACT-1010) and matching description.

scenarios.name: Missing Activity ID with Clear Chainage
scenarios.description: Field report lacks Activity ID but specifies clear chainage Km 0.0 to 2.0 and action trenching.

scenarios.name: Local Terminology Mismatch (Jargon)
scenarios.description: Report says 'HDD 16-inch Pullback' instead of formal WBS title 'River HDD Crossing 16-inch Pipe Pullback'.

scenarios.name: Heavy Acronym & Abbreviation Usage
scenarios.description: Report reads 'ROW clrg & grdg Sec 1 Ch 0-2km done'.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous Candidates (Section 1 vs Section 2 Welding)
scenarios.description: Report says '12 joints 16in pipe welded' without specifying Section 1 or Section 2.

scenarios.name: Unmatched Out-of-Scope Field Work
scenarios.description: Report states 'Constructed temporary bypass culvert near stream Ch 12+800' (not in baseline).

scenarios.name: Contradictory Opposing Reports (Contractor vs. QA NDT)
scenarios.description: Contractor DPR claims 100% welding complete; TPIA QA report uploaded same day notes NDT radiography failure on 4 joints.

scenarios.name: Near-Duplicate Field Report Re-submission
scenarios.description: Same 150m trenching quantities submitted twice in separate DPR transmittals 24h apart.

scenarios.name: Delayed Field Reporting (7-day Transmittal Lag)
scenarios.description: Work performed Sept 2 reported in Sept 9 DPR batch.

scenarios.name: Relative Date Phrase Parsing
scenarios.description: Report says 'Shift 2 yesterday completed alignment of Vessel V-101'.

scenarios.name: Granularity Mismatch (N micro-events to 1 macro activity)
scenarios.description: 15 daily shift reports incrementally reporting 10-15 joints welding for 1 macro activity.

scenarios.name: Single Report Describing Multiple WBS Activities
scenarios.description: Report states 'Cleared ROW and completed 200m trenching at Section 1'.

scenarios.name: Active Critical Path Evidence Gap
scenarios.description: Activity ACT-1040 is active on critical path but zero reports received for 8 days.

scenarios.name: Out-of-Sequence Execution Logic Warning
scenarios.description: Pipe lowering reported completed before trench excavation activity is reported started.

scenarios.name: Independent Corroborating Multi-Source Evidence
scenarios.description: DPR entry + attached site photo + QA clearance slip all referencing Pump P-301A erection.
